IC.IC1: Highly active RMS as defined by:

IC2.IC2.1: One relapse in the previous year and at least 1 T1 Gadolinium (Gd)+ lesion
IC2.IC2.2: or 9 or more T2 lesions, while on therapy

IC.IC3: Two or more relapses in the previous year, whether on DMD treatment or not.
IC.IC4: Expanded Disability Status Scale (EDSS) score less than equals to (<=) 5.0.
IC.IC5: Other protocol defined inclusion criteria could apply.
